name: casdoor/casdoor
title: casdoor/casdoor
headline: Casdoor adds identity and gateway for agents and MCP
lede: You can put one open-source auth server in front of LLMs, MCP servers and agents, using standards such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML.

effects.effect: Agents get managed identities instead of shared keys
MCP servers can sit behind standard enterprise login

possibilities.connection: Scenario's MCP lets agents price media jobs and drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal and Unity, SkillSpector scans the skill package before install, and Casdoor puts identity in front of the MCP tools.

possibilities.title: Small MSSPs can sell AI triage with audit-ready evidence mapped to NIST CSF

with.title: AiSOC: self-hostable AI security operations center
817 cybersecurity skills packaged for coding agents

possibilities.connection: AiSOC logs every agent step in a replayable ledger, the 817 skills tie agent actions to MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0, and Casdoor puts standards-based identity in front of the agents, so each decision records who acted, what happened and which control it served.

appearances.headline: Casdoor adds identity and gateway for agents and MCP
appearances.newly_possible: You can put one open-source auth server in front of LLMs, MCP servers and agents, using standards such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML.
appearances.why: Agent deployments need access control, and this bundles it with a web UI and common enterprise sign-in options.
